title: AI intervention workspace
description: Merge the map's AI regional-analysis session (RegionalIntelligencePanel / useRegionalIntelligence) with intervention proposal creation (InterventionSubmitModal / InterventionDrawControl) into one persistent, switchable workspace UI, alongside the existing LayerPanel data-layer dock, so a user can move between an active AI chat and drawing/proposing an intervention without losing either session's state.

dependencies.note: Extends the just-landed AgentInteraction second action ('Propose intervention here' seeding InterventionSubmitModal with the picked point). This track does not re-scope coordinate-picking; it unifies the UI shell around it.

owns: src/components/map/MapView.tsx (agentCoords/interventionCoords state and the two overlay mount points)
src/components/map/AgentInteraction.tsx (button wiring only, no new coordinate logic)
src/components/panels/InterventionSubmitModal.tsx (host/shell change only; form internals largely unchanged)
New workspace shell component(s) under src/components/map/ or src/components/panels/, name TBD in planning
touches: src/stores/regional-intelligence-store.ts (only if open question 1 resolves to a keep-alive/multi-session model; additive fields, not a rewrite of existing actions' external contract)
src/components/map/layer-panel/ (only if open question 2 resolves to extending the dock; no changes to LayerPanel's own sections otherwise)
src/components/map/AGENTS.md, src/components/panels/AGENTS.md (documentation of whatever exception or extension this track lands, per 'One manager, no floating surfaces')
